lines.text: Even here is chilly in the morning.

and hugs the bases of tree -covered hills.
This world is at peace.
In silent resounds,

to emit jazz tuned lyrics that heat and dry the morning dew.

lines.text: I can close a chapter and open a journal stored away
from moments of great clarity.
Words written from life's triumphs to offer a blueprint
of keeping faith alive and as majestic.
When words are read aloud and sung alone as gospels
to the lonely mirror's midnight hours,
the left tears drying with time that is common to past.
